verdict.rationale: The only design-tool evidence is the Figma integration, which embeds Figma prototypes inside ClickUp. That is the reverse direction: nothing shows a designer updating ClickUp task status from within Figma or another design tool. The Public API's task-update endpoints are developer building blocks rather than a shipped capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
